D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR-IA EXERC ITVS, in ex SMKA

Copper alloy nummus of Constantine I Date: 335-337 Diameter 16mm, weight 2.31g Obverse: beaded draped & cuirassed bust facing right Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG Reverse: Two soldiers standing either side of a standard Reverse inscription: GLOR-IA EXERC ITVS, in ex SMKA Mint: Cyzicus (Turkey) Condition: fine
